items.stem: Which Cloud Operations tool is used to explore and chart time-series metrics ad hoc?

options.rationale: Correct: Metrics Explorer builds ad-hoc charts from time-series metrics.
Logging stores and queries log entries, not metric time series.
Error Reporting aggregates application errors, not arbitrary metrics.
Trace analyzes request latency spans, not general metrics.

items.stem: Which TWO are needed to make an alerting policy actually notify a human? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A condition that defines when the policy is triggered
options.rationale: Correct: a condition defines the triggering state.

options.text: At least one notification channel attached to the policy
options.rationale: Correct: without a channel no notification is delivered.
Alerting does not require a specific support plan.
Deleting metrics is unrelated and harmful.

items.explanation: Correct: a policy needs a triggering condition and a notification channel.

items.stem: A service has a 99.9% monthly availability SLO. What does the error budget represent?

options.text: The allowed amount of unavailability (~0.1%) before the SLO is breached
options.rationale: Correct: the error budget is the permitted shortfall from 100%.
An SLO is a target, not a zero-downtime guarantee.

options.text: The monthly billing credit for outages
options.rationale: Error budget is a reliability concept, not a billing credit.

options.text: The number of alerting policies allowed
options.rationale: It has nothing to do with alerting policy count.

items.explanation: Correct: the error budget is the permitted unavailability before the SLO is breached.
